improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating Gideon's core value proposition and the free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. All copy stays factual, uses site-context pricing language, and highlights the three free searches to drive trial conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to run your business smarter. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clearly states what it is, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-friction free trial offer. 'No credit card required' removes a common conversion barrier and builds trust. Copy is concise, benefit-driven, and aligned with the professional tone.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model: what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the transition and reinforcing value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace) alongside transparent pricing, it reduces uncertainty and builds trust, which supports conversion.
